title: Fact-Check Challenge: Is This Post True?

body.en: A post going around your group chat claims: 'Scientists actually agree climate change is just a natural cycle — it has nothing to do with human activity.' How should you classify this?

choices.label: False — the overwhelming scientific consensus is that human activity is the main driver of the climate change happening now
choices.consequence: Correct. Earth's climate has changed naturally before, but the specific, rapid warming happening now closely tracks the rise in human greenhouse gas emissions — that's not a natural-cycle coincidence, it's a well-established scientific finding.

choices.label: Accurate — climate has always changed naturally, so this checks out
choices.consequence: This is the exact trick the claim relies on: it's true that climate has changed naturally in Earth's deep past, but that fact is being used to misleadingly wave away the current, human-driven warming — a different thing entirely.

choices.label: Can't be verified either way, so best to just share it and let people decide
choices.consequence: This claim can be checked — it contradicts the documented scientific consensus. Sharing unverified claims that sound plausible is exactly how climate misinformation spreads.
